about-me.title: About Me
about-me.description: As a junior front-end developer, I combine technical expertise from the Developer Academy with a strong user perspective. Whereas I used to just support software requirements, I now write the code to bring them to life. This change in perspective inspires me every day and makes programming the perfect blend of logic and creativity. I work tirelessly on clean solutions and value the professional exchange within the team. It motivates me to transform abstract ideas into functioning applications step by step. My goal is to develop myself further in the long term and to advance innovative projects with high-quality code.
